<link rel="stylesheet" href="~/css/stylekorzina.css"> 
<script> 
    $(function () { 
    $.ajaxSetup({ cache: false }); 
    $(".changepassword").click(function (e) {         e.preventDefault(); 
        $.get(this.href, function (data) { 
            $('#dialogContent').html(data); 
            $('#modDialog').show(); 
        }); 
    }); 
    $(".changeinfo").click(function (e) {         e.preventDefault(); 
        $.get(this.href, function (data) { 
            $('#dialogContent').html(data); 
            $('#modDialog').show(); 
        }); 
    }); 
    $(".cancelaccount").click(function (e) {         e.preventDefault(); 
        $.get(this.href, function (data) { 
            $('#dialogContent').html(data); 
            $('#modDialog').show(); 
        }); 
    }); 
}); 
</script> 
 
OrderUser.cshtml 
@model ModelOrder 
@{ 
    ViewData["Title"] = "Заказ №"+Model.OrderInformation.OrderNumber; } 
 
<script src="~/lib/jquery-validation/dist/jquery.validate.min.js" defer></script> 
<script src="~/lib/jquery-validation-unobtrusive/jquery.validate.unobtrusive.min.js" defer></script> 
<script src="https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/3.1.1/jquery.min.js"></script> 
<main class="content-main"> 
    <div class="con-man"> 
        <div class="main-div-left"> 
            <main class="main"> 
                <header class="page-header"> 
                    <h1>Заказ №@Model.OrderInformation.OrderNumber от @Model.OrderInformation.DateOrder</h1> 
                </header> 
                @if(Model.OrderInformation.DateReadyToExtradition != null) 
                { 
                    <div><p>Дата и время завершения сборки: 
@Model.OrderInformation.DateReadyToExtradition</p></div> 
                } 
                @if(Model.OrderInformation.Status != 4 && Model.OrderInformation.DateExtradition != null) 
                { 
                    <div><p>Дата и время выдачи клиенту: @Model.OrderInformation.DateExtradition</p></div> 
                } 
                @if(Model.OrderInformation.Status == 4 && Model.OrderInformation.DateExtradition != null) 
                { 
                    <div><p>Дата и время отмены заказа: @Model.OrderInformation.DateExtradition</p></div> 
                } 
                @if (Model.OrderInformation.Status == 0) 
                { 
                    <p class="dostavka" style="max-width: 200px; align-items: center; text-align: center; background: 
#fff495; font-weight: bold; cursor: default;">Создан. Ожидает подтверждения</p> 
                } 
                else if (Model.OrderInformation.Status == 1) 
                { 
                    <p class="dostavka" style="max-width: 200px; align-items: center; text-align: center; background: 
#c4daff; font-weight: bold; cursor: default;">Подтверждён. Сборка</p> 
                } 
                else if (Model.OrderInformation.Status == 2) 
                { 
                    <p class="dostavka" style="max-width: 200px; align-items: center; color: white; text-align: center; background: #2780ff; font-weight: bold; cursor: default;">Ожидает выдачи</p> 
                } 
                else if (Model.OrderInformation.Status == 3) 
                { 
                    <p class="dostavka" style="max-width: 200px; align-items: center; color: white; text-align: center; background: #3ebb46; font-weight: bold; cursor: default;">Завершён. Выдан покупателю</p> 
                } 
                else if (Model.OrderInformation.Status == 4) 
                { 
                    <p class="dostavka" style="max-width: 260px; align-items: center; text-align: center; color: white; background: #555054; font-weight: bold; cursor: default; ">Завершён. Отменён</p> 
                } 
                else if (Model.OrderInformation.Status == 5) 
                { 
                    <p class="dostavka" style="max-width: 200px; align-items: center; text-align: center; background: 
#2780ff; font-weight: bold; cursor: default;">Полный возврат</p> 
                } 
                else if (Model.OrderInformation.Status == 6) 
                { 
                    <p class="dostavka" style="max-width: 200px; align-items: center; text-align: center; background: 
#2780ff; font-weight: bold; cursor: default;">Частичный возврат</p> 
                } 
                    <div class="basket"> 
                            <div class="basket__row basket__row_header"> 
                                <div class="basket__col basket__col_image-header"></div> 
                                <div class="basket__col basket__col_name">Наименование товара</div> 
                                <div class="basket__col basket__col_quanity-header">Количество</div> 
                                <div class="basket__col basket__col_price-header">Цена</div> 
                            </div> 
                            @foreach (var a in Model.OrderInformation.OrderContainers) 
                            { 
                                <div class="basket-item"> 
                                    <div class="basket__row"> 
                                        <div class="basket__col basket__col_image"> 
                                            <img src="@a.Goods.FtppathImage" alt="product image"> 
                                        </div> 
                                        <div class="basket__col basket__col_name"> 
                                            <div class="basket-item__name"> 
                                                <a asp-action="Tovar" asp-controller="Categori" asp-route-
id="@a.Goods.IdGood"><b>@a.Goods.Manufacture.NameManufacture</b> @a.Goods.Name</a> 
                                            </div> 
                                        </div> 
                                        <div class="basket__col basket__col_quanity"> 
                                            <div class="number-input"> 
                                                <input readonly="readonly" type="number" class="input number-input__input" value="@a.Count"> 
                                            </div> 
                                        </div> 
                                        <div class="basket__col basket__col_price"> 
                                            <div class="basket-price"> 
                                                @((a.Count * Convert.ToDouble(a.Price)).ToString())<span class="basketprice__currency">₽</span> 
                                            </div> 
                                        </div> 
                                    </div> 
                                </div> 
                            } 
                            <div class="basket__col basket__col_footer"> 
                                <div style="text-align:left; margin-left:25px;" class="basket-summary"> 
                                    <div>Общая стоимость товаров: @Model.summa ₽</div> 
                                </div>                            </div> 
                            <div class="card checkout" style="border-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; margin: 0;">                                 <div class="checkout__title"> 
                                    <div class="checkout__step">2</div>                                     Способ получения 
                                </div> 
                                <div id="deliveryContainer"> 
                                    <div class="profiles-form checkout__profile"> 
                                        <div class="profiles-form__section"> 
                                            <div class="profiles-form__title">Филиал</div> 
                                                <div class="profiles-form__block" style="width:100%;"> 
                                                    <div class="form-group profiles-form__input" style="display: flex; width:100%;"> 
                                                        <label 
for="gr_@Model.OrderInformation.Filial.IdFilial"><b>@Model.OrderInformation.Filial.NameFilial</b> (<a href="https://yandex.ru/maps/213/moscow/search/@Model.OrderInformation.Filial.AddressFilial" target="_blank">@Model.OrderInformation.Filial.AddressFilial</a>)</label> 
                                                    </div> 
                                                </div> 
                                        </div> 
                                    </div> 
                                </div> 
                            </div> 
 
                            <div class="card checkout" style="border-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none;"> 
                                <div class="checkout__title"> 
                                    <div class="checkout__step">3</div>                                     Контактная информация 
                                </div> 
                                <div class="profiles-form checkout__profile"> 
                                    <div class="profiles-form__section"> 
                                        <div class="profiles-form__block profiles-form__block_wide"> 
                                                <div class="form-group profiles-form__input"> 
                                                    <label class="form-group__label form-group__label_required">                                                         Контактное лицо                                                     </label> 
                                                    <p class="form-group__input">@Model.contacts.Contact_Name</p> 
                                                </div> 
                                        </div> 
 
                                        <div class="profiles-form__block"> 
                                            <div class="form-group profiles-form__input"> 
                                                  <label class="form-group__label form-group__label_required"> 
                                                        E-mail                                                     </label> 
                                                    <p class="form-group__input" required="">@Model.contacts.Contact_Email</p> 
                                            </div> 
                                        </div> 
 
                                        <div class="profiles-form__block"> 
                                            <div class="form-group profiles-form__input"> 
                                               <label class="form-group__label form-group__label_required">                                                     Телефон (моб)                                                 </label> 
                                                <p class="form-group__input">@Model.contacts.Contact_Telefon</p> 
                                            </div> 
                                        </div> 
                                    </div> 
                                </div> 
                            </div> 
                            @if(Model.OrderInformation.SborshikUser != null) 
                            { 
                                <div><p style="margin-left: 30px;">Сборщик: 
@Model.OrderInformation.SborshikUser.FirstName 
@Model.OrderInformation.SborshikUser.LastName</p></div> 
                            } 
                            @if(Model.OrderInformation.SellerUser != null) 
                            { 
                                <div><p style="margin-left: 30px;">Продавец (осуществил возврат): 
@Model.OrderInformation.SellerUser.FirstName @Model.OrderInformation.SellerUser.LastName</p></div> 
                            } 
                            @if(Model.OrderInformation.Status < 3) 
                            { 
                                <div class="basket__row basket__row_footer"> 
                                    <div class="basket__col basket__col_footer"> 
                                        <div class="basket-submit"> 
                                            <a asp-action="CancelOrder" asp-controller="Home" asp-routeid="@Model.OrderInformation.OrderNumber" style="background-color: #c62306; border-color: #c62306; color: 
#fff;" class="btn btn_primary basket-submit__btn" >Отменить заказ</a> 
                                        </div> 
                                    </div> 
                                </div> 
                            } 
                        </div> 
            </main> 
        </div> 
        <div class="notmain-div-right"> 
            <div class="block-right"> 
                <aside class="aside aside_user"> 
                    <div class="aside__user-info"> 
                        <div class="user-line"> 
                            <div class="user-line__avatar"> 
                                <img src="https://vasko.ru/images/user_outline.svg" alt="avatar"> 
                            </div> 
                            <div class="user-line__name"> 
                                <div>                                     @{ 
                                        string g = User.Identity.Name;                                         g = g.Substring(g.IndexOf(' ') + 1); 
                                        <b> 
                                            @g 
                                        </b> 
                                    } 
                                </div> 
                            </div> 
                        </div> 
                        <menu class="user-menu"> 
                            <li class="user-menu__item"> 
                                <a asp-action="MyOrders" asp-controller="Home" class="user-menu__link usermenu__item_active"> 
                                    <svg class="icon user-menu__icon" width="27" height="23" viewBox="0 0 27 23" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                <form asp-controller="Home" asp-action="RegistrateUser" class="callback-from"> 
                    <input name="IsValid" type="hidden" value="@ViewData.ModelState.IsValid.ToString()" />                     <div class="form-zap"> 
                        <label class="required" for="email">E-mail</label> 
                        <input type="text" asp-for="Email" class="inputs imz-in"> 
                        <span asp-validation-for="Email" style="color: red;"></span>

                        <label class="required" for="password">Пароль</label> 
                        <input type="password" asp-for="Password" class="inputs imz-in">                         <span asp-validation-for="Password" style="color: red;"></span> 
                    </div>

                        <input type="password" asp-for="ConfirmPassword" class="inputs imz-in"> 
                        <span asp-validation-for="ConfirmPassword" style="color: red;"></span> 
                    </div> 
                    <div class="form-zap"> 
                        <label class="required" for="ima">Имя</label> 
                        <input type="text" asp-for="Ima" class="inputs imz-in"> 
                        <span asp-validation-for="Ima" style="color: red;"></span> 
                    </div>

                        <label class="required" for="ima">Фамилия</label> 
                        <input type="text" asp-for="Familia" class="inputs imz-in">

                        //e.preventDefault(); 
                        var form = $(this).parents('.modal').find('form');                         var actionUrl = form.attr('action');                         var dataToSend = form.serialize(); 
 
                        $.post(actionUrl, dataToSend).done(function (data) { 
                            var newBody = $('.modal-body', data);

                            var isValid = newBody.find('[name="IsValid"]').val() == 'True';                             console.log(newBody.find('[name="IsValid"]').val());

== 'True') {

0.955553 1.31057 0.907721 1.38887L0.266555 2.43695C0.243636 2.47448 0.236494 2.51965 0.246791 
2.5625C0.257089 2.60535 0.283994 2.64231 0.321529 2.66531L2.50354 3.99996L0.321529 5.33469C0.283994 
5.35761 0.257089 5.39465 0.246791 5.43741C0.236494 5.48034 0.243636 5.52552 0.266555 5.56305L0.907721 
6.61104C0.955553 6.68927 1.05769 6.71401 1.13609 6.66618L3.21902 5.39199V7.83383C3.21902 7.92551

_CartTovari.cshtml 
@model TovariInCart                                   
@foreach (var items in Model.list_tovari) 
                            { 
                                <div class="basket-item"> 
                                    <div class="basket__row"> 
                                        <div class="basket__col basket__col_image"> 
                                            <img src="@items.Goods.FtppathImage" alt="product image"> 
                                        </div> 
                                        <div class="basket__col basket__col_name"> 
                                            <div class="basket-item__name"> 
                                                <a asp-action="Tovar" asp-controller="Categori" asp-route-
id="@items.GoodsId"><b>@items.Goods.Manufacture.NameManufacture</b> @items.Goods.Name</a> 
                                            </div> 
                                        </div> 
                                        <div class="basket__col basket__col_quanity"> 
                                            <div class="number-input"> 
                                                <a style="height: 50%;" id="do-@items.IdKorzinaGood" class="number-input__btn btn_primary minus" data-decrease=""> 
                                                    <svg style="display: block; margin: 4px auto;" class="icon" width="9" height="6" viewBox="0 0 9 6" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"> 
                                                        <path d="M8.59117 1.56267C8.77524 1.36954 8.77524 1.06591 8.59117 
0.872772L8.28019 0.546462C8.08317 0.339729 7.75331 0.33973 7.55629 0.546462L4.98895 3.24033C4.79192 
3.44707 4.46206 3.44707 4.26504 3.24033L1.6977 0.546462C1.50068 0.339729 1.17082 0.339729 0.973798 
0.546461L0.662814 0.872771C0.478749 1.06591 0.478749 1.36954 0.662814 1.56267L4.26504 5.34244C4.46206 
5.54917 4.79192 5.54917 4.98894 5.34244L8.59117 1.56267Z" fill="white" /> 
                                                    </svg>                                                 </a> 
                                                <input readonly="readonly" type="number" id="kolichest-@items.IdKorzinaGood" class="input number-input__input" min="1" value="@items.Count" name="product-quantity" data-basketcode="20918014" data-product-id="1577992"> 
                                                <a style="height: 50%;" id="up-@items.IdKorzinaGood" class="number-input__btn btn_primary addplus" data-increase=""> 
                                                    <svg style="display: block; margin: 4px auto;" class="icon" width="9" height="6" viewBox="0 0 9 6" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"> 
                                                        <path d="M0.634901 4.15956C0.450837 4.35269 0.450836 4.65632 0.634901 
4.84946L0.945884 5.17577C1.14291 5.3825 1.47277 5.3825 1.66979 5.17577L4.23713 2.4819C4.43415 2.27516 
4.76401 2.27516 4.96103 2.4819L7.52837 5.17577C7.7254 5.3825 8.05525 5.3825 8.25228 5.17577L8.56326 
4.84946C8.74733 4.65632 8.74733 4.35269 8.56326 4.15956L4.96103 0.379793C4.76401 0.173061 4.43415 
0.17306 4.23713 0.379793L0.634901 4.15956Z" fill="white" /> 
                                                    </svg> 
                                                </a> 
                                            </div> 
                                        </div> 
 
                                        <div class="basket__col basket__col_price"> 
                                            <div class="basket-price"> 
                                                @((items.Count * Convert.ToDouble(items.Goods.Cost)).ToString())<span class="basket-price__currency">₽</span> 
                                            </div> 
                                        </div> 
 
                                        <div class="basket__col basket__col_actions"> 
                                            <div> 
                                                <a onclick="return false;" 
href="api/Korzina/DeleteFromCart/@items.IdKorzinaGood" class="btn btn_transparent basket-action deletefrombuske"> 
                                                    Удалить 
                                                </a> 
                                            </div> 
                                        </div> 
                                    </div> 
                                </div> 
                            } 
                            <div class="basket__col basket__col_footer"> 
                                <div style="text-align:left; margin-left:25px;" class="basket-summary"> 
                                    <div>Общая стоимость товаров: @Model.summa ₽</div> 
                                </div> 
                           </div>                           <script>                            var initial; 
                           $(".deletefrombuske").click(function () { 
                                       $.ajax({ 
                                            type: "DELETE",                                             url: $(this).attr("href"),                                             dataType: "text"                                         }).done(function() { 
                                            var urls = '@Url.Action("GetCartTovari", "Korzina")'; 
                                            $('#panel_cart').load(urls); 
                                        }); 
                            }); 
 
                            $(".addplus").click(function() { 
                              addplus($(this)); 
                            }) 
                            function addplus(thisObj){                                 clearTimeout(initial);                                 var thisObj = thisObj;                                 var id = $(thisObj).attr("id");                                 id = id.substring(3, id.length +1); 
                                if (Number(document.getElementById('kolichest-'+id).value) + 1 < 50) { 
                                    document.getElementById('kolichest-'+id).value = Number(document.getElementById('kolichest-'+id).value) + 1; 
                                    var newKolvo = document.getElementById('kolichest-'+id).value;                                     initial = setTimeout(function() { 
                                        $.ajax({                                             type: "PUT", 
                                            url: 'api/Korzina/UpdateCart/'+id+'/'+newKolvo,                                             dataType: "text"                                         }).done(function() { 
                                            var urls = '@Url.Action("GetCartTovari", "Korzina")';                                             $('#panel_cart').load(urls); 
                                        }); 
                                    }, 500); 
                                }                                 else 
                                    alert("Уж очень много товаров, низя так, оформите заказ и сообщите оператору, сколько Вам нужно товаров!"); 
                            }; 
 
                            $(".minus").click(function() { 
                              minus($(this)); 
                            }) 
                            function minus(thisObj){                                 clearTimeout(initial);                                 var thisObj = thisObj;                                 var id = $(thisObj).attr("id");                                 id = id.substring(3, id.length +1); 
                                if (Number(document.getElementById('kolichest-'+id).value) - 1 > 0) {                                     document.getElementById('kolichest-'+id).value = Number(document.getElementById('kolichest-'+id).value) - 1; 
                                    var newKolvo = document.getElementById('kolichest-'+id).value;                                     initial = setTimeout(function() { 
                                        $.ajax({                                             type: "PUT", 
                                            url: 'api/Korzina/UpdateCart/'+id+'/'+newKolvo,                                             dataType: "text"                                         }).done(function() { 
                                            var urls = '@Url.Action("GetCartTovari", "Korzina")';                                             $('#panel_cart').load(urls); 
                                        }); 
                                    }, 500); 
                                }                                 else 
                                    alert("Низя меньше единицы товаров"); 
                            }; 
                        </script>

@model informationPreOformleine 
@{

} 
 
<script src="~/lib/jquery-validation/dist/jquery.validate.min.js" defer></script>

<main class="content-main">

            <main class="main">

                    <h1>Проверьте заказ</h1>

                @if(Model.tovaris_false.Count() > 0) 
                { 
                    <h3>Часть товаров отсутвует в наличии. Мы их удалили из корзины, или добавили в список товаров для оформления то количество, которое доступно в филиале</h3>

                            <div class="basket__col basket__col_name">Наименование товара</div> 
                            <div class="basket__col basket__col_quanity-header">Количество</div> 
                            <div class="basket__col basket__col_quanity-header">Доступно в филиале</div> 
                            <div class="basket__col basket__col_price-header">Цена</div> 
                        </div> 
                   @for (int i =0; i< Model.tovaris_false.Count();i++) 
                   { 
                       <div style="display:none;"> 
                                    <input type="text" asp-for="@Model.tovaris_false[i].GoodsId"> 
                                    <input type="text" asp-for="@Model.tovaris_false[i].Count"> 
                                    <input type="text" asp-for="@Model.tovaris_false[i].Goods.Cost"> 
                        </div>

                            <div class="basket__row">

                                        <a asp-action="Tovar" asp-controller="Categori" asp-route-
id="@Model.tovaris_false[i].GoodsId"><b>@Model.tovaris_false[i].Goods.Manufacture.NameManufacture</b> @Model.tovaris_false[i].Goods.Name</a> 
                                    </div> 
                                </div> 
                                <div class="basket__col basket__col_quanity"> 
                                    <div class="number-input"> 
                                        <input readonly="readonly" type="number" class="input number-input__input" min="1" value="@Model.tovaris_false[i].Count" name="product-quantity" data-basket-code="20918014" data-productid="1577992"> 
                                    </div> 
                                </div> 
                                <div class="basket__col basket__col_quanity"> 
                                    <div class="number-input"> 
                                        <p style="line-height: 0;">@Model.tovaris_false[i].count_filial</p> 
                                    </div> 
                                </div> 
                                <div class="basket__col basket__col_price"> 
                                    <div class="basket-price"> 
                                        @((Model.tovaris_false[i].Count * 
Convert.ToDouble(Model.tovaris_false[i].Goods.Cost)).ToString())<span class="basketprice__currency">₽</span> 
                                    </div> 
                                </div> 
                            </div> 
                       </div> 
                    } 
                    </div> 
                }

_ConfirmBlock.cshtml 
@model BeforeDeleteCadri; 
<div class="modal-content"> 
    <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="~/css/style_list.css" /> 
    <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="~/css/styleInputFile.css" /> 
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/icon?family=Material+Icons" rel="stylesheet"> 
    <div class="modal-windows"> 
        <div class="obratnii-zvonok"> 
            <div class="form-edit fformms" style="padding: 30px; background-color: #fff; border-radius: 5px; boxshadow: 1px 1px 10px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 12%); color: #696969; "> 
                <div class="zvonok-title">Вы уверены, что желаете заблокировать аккаунт данного сотрудника?</div> 
                    <div> 
                        <div class="form-zap"> 
                            <label asp-for="@Model.FI" class="required"></label> 
                            <input class="inputs imz-in" value="@Model.FI" readonly> 
                        </div> 
                    </div> 
                    <div class="form-zap"> 
                        <div class="btn-center"> 
                            <input class="sbm-zvonok" id="submitDelete" type="submit" value="Заблокировать" /> 
                        </div> 
                    </div> 
                    <div class="btn-center"> 
                        <button class="sbm-zvonok otm" style="background-color: #c4c4c4; margin-top: 15px; color: White;" onclick='$(".modal-content").remove();'>Отмена</button> 
                    </div> 
            </div> 
        </div> 
    </div> 
    <script> 
        $( "#submitDelete" ).click(function() { 
          fetch('api/Workers/BlockAccount/@Model.ID_Worker', { method: 'GET' }) 
            .then(() => { 
                $('#panel').load(urls); 
                $(".modal-content").remove(); 
            }); 
        }); 
    </script> 
</div> 
 
_ConfirmDelete.cshtml 
@model BeforeDeleteCadri; 
<div class="modal-content"> 
    <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="~/css/style_list.css" /> 
    <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="~/css/styleInputFile.css" /> 
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/icon?family=Material+Icons" rel="stylesheet"> 
    <div class="modal-windows"> 
        <div class="obratnii-zvonok"> 
            <div class="form-edit fformms" style="padding: 30px; background-color: #fff; border-radius: 5px; boxshadow: 1px 1px 10px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 12%); color: #696969; "> 
                <div class="zvonok-title">Вы уверены, что желаете уволить данного сотрудника?</div> 
                    <div> 
                        <div class="form-zap"> 
                            <label asp-for="@Model.FI" class="required"></label> 
                            <input class="inputs imz-in" value="@Model.FI" readonly> 
                        </div> 
                        <div class="form-zap"> 
                            <label asp-for="@Model.PrikazObUval" class="required"></label> 
                            <input class="inputs imz-in" id="prikaz" value="@Model.PrikazObUval" placeholder="Если приказа нет, напишите 'Не указан'"> 
                            <span asp-validation-for="@Model.PrikazObUval" style="color: red;"></span> 
                        </div> 
                    </div> 
                    <div class="form-zap"> 
                        <div class="btn-center"> 
                            <input class="sbm-zvonok" id="submitDelete" type="submit" value="Уволить" /> 
                        </div> 
                    </div> 
                    <div class="btn-center"> 
                        <button class="sbm-zvonok otm" style="background-color: #c4c4c4; margin-top: 15px; color: White;" onclick='$(".modal-content").remove();'>Отмена</button> 
                    </div> 
            </div> 
        </div> 
    </div> 
    <script> 
        $( "#submitDelete" ).click(function() {             if($("#prikaz").val() == null)                 $("#prikaz").val("Не указан");             else if($("#prikaz").val().trim() == "") 
                $("#prikaz").val("Не указан"); 
          fetch('api/Workers/@Model.ID_Worker/'+$("#prikaz").val(), { method: 'DELETE' }) 
            .then(() => { 
                $('#panel').load(urls); 
                $(".modal-content").remove(); 
            }); 
        }); 
    </script> 
</div>

_ListCadri.cshtml 
@model IndexPageCadri; 
<link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="~/css/style_list.css" /> 
<link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="~/css/style_table.css" /> 
@addTagHelper *, KursovoiProject_ElShop   
<script type="text/javascript" src="~/js/script_list.js" defer></script>     
    <div class="table-responsive custom-table-responsive" style="padding-bottom: 20px;"> 
            <table class="table custom-table" style="width: 100%; min-width: 0px;"> 
                <thead> 
                    <tr> 
                        <th scope="col">Фамилия имя</th>                         <th scope="col">Номер телефона</th>                         <th scope="col">Дата рождения</th> 
                        <th scope="col">Филиал(ы) работы</th> 
                        <th scope="col">Роли на сайте</th> 
                        <th scope="col">Заблокирован</th>                         <th scope="col">Приказ о приёме</th> 
                        @if(Model.statusSite == 1) 
                        { 
                            <th scope="col">Приказ об увольнении</th> 
                        } 
                        <th scope="col">Действия</th> 
                    </tr> 
                </thead> 
                <tbody> 
 
                    @foreach (var item in Model.listCadri) 
                    { 
                    <tr> 
                        <td>@item.Familia @item.Ima</td> 
                        <td>@item.phoneNumber</td> 
                        <td>@item.DateOfBirth</td> 
                        <td> 
                            @foreach(var a in item.listFilial) 
                            { 
                                <div><p style="margin: 0.35rem;">@a.NameFilial</p></div> 
                            } 
                        </td> 
                        <td> 
                            @foreach(var a in item.listRoles) 
                            { 
                                <div><p style="margin: 0.35rem;">@a.NameRole</p></div> 
                            } 
                        </td> 
                        <td> 
                            @if(item.avail == true) 
                            { 
                                <p style="color: green;">Аккаунт НЕ заблокирован</p> 
                            }                             else                             { 
                                <p style="color: red;">Аккаунт заблокирован</p> 
                            } 
                        </td> 
                        <td>@item.PrikazOPrieme</td> 
                        @if(Model.statusSite == 1) 
                        { 
                            <td>@item.PrikazObUval</td> 
                        } 
                        <td> 
                            <a asp-action="AddEditCadri" asp-controller="ManageCadri" asp-route-id="@item.ID_Worker"> 
                                <div style="cursor:pointer; text-decoration: none; margin-right: 15px;"> 
                                    <svg enable-background="new 0 0 24 24" height="25" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="25" style="fill: #C62306;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="m19 12c-.553 0-1 .448-1 1v8c0 .551-.448 1-1 1h-14c-.552 0-1-.449-1-1v-14c0-.551.448-1 1-1h8c.553 0 1-.448 1-1s-.447-1-1-1h-8c-1.654 0-3 1.346-3 3v14c0 
1.654 1.346 3 3 3h14c1.654 0 3-1.346 3-3v-8c0-.553-.447-1-1-1z" /><path d="m9.376 11.089c-.07.07-.117.159.137.255l-.707 3.536c-.033.164.019.333.137.452.095.095.223.146.354.146.032 0 .065-.003.098-.01l3.535.707c.098-.02.187-.067.256-.137l7.912-7.912-3.535-3.535z" /><path d="m23.268.732c-.975-.975-2.561-.975-3.535 0l-1.384 1.384 3.535 3.535 1.384-1.384c.472-.471.732-1.099.732-1.767s-.26-1.296-.732-1.768z" /></svg> 
                                </div> 
                            </a> 
                            @if(Model.statusSite == 0) 
                            { 
                                @if(item.avail == true) 
                                { 
                                    <div onclick="blockConfirm('@item.ID_Worker')" style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom:

AddEditCadri.cshtml 
@model AddEditCadri; 
<link rel="stylesheet" href="~/css/styletovarilist.css"> 
<script src="~/lib/jQuery-Mask-Plugin-master/dist/jquery.mask.js"></script> 
@{ 
    @if(Model.ID_Worker == 0){ ViewData["Title"] = "Добавление сотрудника"; }     else{ ViewData["Title"] = "Изменение сотрудника"; } 
} 
<style> 
    .hr-line { 
 	    margin: 20px 0;  	    padding: 0;  	    height: 0;  	    border: none;  	    border-top: 1px solid #333; 
    } 
    .table_roles { 
        width: 100%; 
    } 
 
    .table_roles tr { 
        border-bottom: none; 
    } 
 
    .table_roles th {         color: black;         text-align: left;         font-weight: normal;         vertical-align: top; 
    } 
 
    .table_roles th:first-child {         width: 180px; 
    } 
 
    .table_roles tr th:first-child {         color: rgb(103, 103, 103); 
        font-weight: bold; 
    } 
 
    .table_roles th div { 
        margin-bottom: 15px; 
    } 
    .search {         display: inline-flex; 
        border: 1px solid rgb(152, 152, 152);         /* border-radius: 30px; */         padding: 5px;         width: 60%; 
    } 
 
    .search-icon {         width: 20px;         height: 20px;         margin-right: 10px;         order: -1; 
    } 
 
    .search-field { 
        border: 0;         font-size: 14px;         width: 100%; 
        background-color: transparent; 
    } 
 
    .search-field:focus {         outline: none; 
    } 
    .search-results { 
        border: 1px solid rgb(152, 152, 152);         max-height: 350px;         position: relative;         overflow-y: auto;         padding: 10px; 
    } 
</style> 
<main class="content-main" style="max-width: 1190px; margin: 0 auto; flex-direction: row; justify-content: spacebetween; align-items: stretch; max-width: 1190px; padding: 0 13px;">     <div style="padding-top: 25px;" id="panel">         <h1 style="text-align: center;">@if (Model.ID_Worker == 0) { <text>Добавление</text> }else{ 
<text>Изменение</text>} сотрудника</h1> 
        <form asp-action="AddEditCadriPost" asp-controller="ManageCadri" asp-route-id="@Model.ID_Worker" style="width: 50%; margin: 0 auto;" method="post" class="callback-from" enctype="multipart/form-data">             <div class="form-zap"> 
                <label asp-for="@Model.First_Name" class="required"></label> 
                <input type="text" asp-for="@Model.First_Name" class="inputs imz-in" /> 
                <span asp-validation-for="@Model.First_Name" style="color: red;"></span> 
            </div> 
            <div class="form-zap"> 
                <label asp-for="@Model.Last_Name" class="required"></label> 
                <input type="text" asp-for="@Model.Last_Name" class="inputs imz-in" /> 
                <span asp-validation-for="@Model.Last_Name" style="color: red;"></span> 
            </div> 
            <div class="form-zap"> 
                <label asp-for="@Model.INN" class="required"></label> 
                <input type="text" asp-for="@Model.INN" id="inn" class="inputs imz-in" /> 
                <span asp-validation-for="@Model.INN" style="color: red;"></span> 
            </div> 
            <div class="form-zap"> 
                <label asp-for="@Model.SNILS" class="required"></label> 
                <input id="snils" type="text" asp-for="@Model.SNILS" class="inputs imz-in" />                 <span asp-validation-for="@Model.SNILS" style="color: red;"></span> 
            </div> 
            <div class="form-zap"> 
                <label asp-for="@Model.SeriaPasport" class="required"></label> 
                <input type="number" id="serpasp" asp-for="@Model.SeriaPasport" class="inputs imz-in" /> 
                <span asp-validation-for="@Model.SeriaPasport" style="color: red;"></span> 
            </div> 
            <div class="form-zap"> 
                <label asp-for="@Model.NomerPasport" class="required"></label> 
                <input type="number" id="numbpasp" asp-for="@Model.NomerPasport" class="inputs imz-in" />                 <span asp-validation-for="@Model.NomerPasport" style="color: red;"></span> 
            </div> 
            <div class="form-zap"> 
                <label asp-for="@Model.DateOfBirth" class="required"></label> 
                <input type="date" asp-for="@Model.DateOfBirth" class="inputs imz-in" /> 
                <span asp-validation-for="@Model.DateOfBirth" style="color: red;"></span> 
            </div> 
            <div class="form-zap"> 
                <label asp-for="@Model.AddressRegistration" class="required"></label> 
                <input type="text" asp-for="@Model.AddressRegistration" class="inputs imz-in" /> 
                <span asp-validation-for="@Model.AddressRegistration" style="color: red;"></span> 
            </div> 
            <div class="form-zap"> 
                <label asp-for="@Model.Login" class="required"></label> 
                <input type="text" asp-for="@Model.Login" class="inputs imz-in" /> 
                <span asp-validation-for="@Model.Login" style="color: red;"></span> 
            </div> 
            @if (Model.ID_Worker == 0) 
            { 
                <p style="font-style: italic;">Пароль будет направлен пользователю по указанному email.</p> 
            } 
            @if (Model.ID_Worker > 0) 
            { 
                <p style="font-style: italic;">При изменении логина пароль пользователя будет сброшен и направлен ему на новую указанную почту.</p> 
            } 
            <div class="form-zap"> 
                <label asp-for="@Model.Telefon" class="required"></label> 
                <input type="text" id="phonenumber" asp-for="@Model.Telefon" class="inputs imz-in" />                 <span asp-validation-for="@Model.Telefon" style="color: red;"></span> 
            </div> 
            <div class="form-zap"> 
                <label asp-for="@Model.PrikazOPrinat" class="required"></label> 
                <input type="text" placeholder="если нет, то напишите - не указан" asp-for="@Model.PrikazOPrinat" class="inputs imz-in" /> 
                <span asp-validation-for="@Model.PrikazOPrinat" style="color: red;"></span> 
            </div> 
            @if(@Model.PrikazObUval != null) 
            { 
                    <div class="form-zap"> 
                        <label asp-for="@Model.PrikazObUval" class="required"></label> 
                        <input type="text" asp-for="@Model.PrikazObUval" class="inputs imz-in" /> 
                        <span asp-validation-for="@Model.PrikazObUval" style="color: red;"></span> 
                    </div>                                               
            } 
            <hr class="hr-line" /> 
                <label class="required">Роли в системе</label> 
                <table class="table_roles" style="height: fit-content;"> 
                    <tr> 
                        <th> 
                            <div> 
                                <div class="search-results"> 
                                    <div class="checkboxes_element"> 
                                        @for(int i=0;i< Model.roles.Count();i++) 
                                        { 
                                            @if(Model.roles[i].ID_Role != 21 && Model.roles[i].ID_Role != 22) 
                                            { 
                                                <div style="display:none;"> 
                                                    <input type="text" asp-for="@Model.roles[i].ID_Role"> 
                                                    <input type="text" asp-for="@Model.roles[i].NameRole"> 
                                                </div> 
                                                <input type="checkbox" asp-for="@Model.roles[i].IsSelected" class="customcheckbox child" id="grou_@Model.roles[i].ID_Role"> 
                                                <label class="child_el search__element_orgped" for="grou_@Model.roles[i].ID_Role">@Model.roles[i].NameRole</label> 
                                                <div></div> 
                                            } 
                                        } 
                                    </div> 
                                </div> 
                            </div> 
                        </th> 
                    </tr> 
                </table> 
                <span asp-validation-for="@Model.roles" style="color: red;"></span>             <hr class="hr-line" /> 
            <label class="required">Филиал</label> 
            <table class="table_roles" style="height: fit-content;"> 
                <tr> 
                    <th> 
                        <div> 
                            <div class="search" style="margin-bottom: 0px; width:100%;"> 
                                <input type="text" onkeyup="search_group()" id="search-field_orgped" class="search-field" style="width: 100%;" placeholder="Введите наименование филиала"> 
                                <img src="~/images/search.svg" alt="" class="search-icon"> 
                            </div> 
                            <div class="search-results"> 
                                <div class="checkboxes_element"> 
                                    @for(int i=0;i< Model.filials.Count();i++) 
                                    { 
                                        <div style="display:none;"> 
                                            <input type="text" asp-for="@Model.filials[i].ID_Filial"> 
                                            <input type="text" asp-for="@Model.filials[i].NameFilial"> 
                                            <input type="text" asp-for="@Model.filials[i].IsAvalib"> 
                                        </div> 
                                        <input type="checkbox" asp-for="@Model.filials[i].IsSelected" class="custom-checkbox child" id="group_@Model.filials[i].ID_Filial"> 
                                        <label class="child_el search__element_orgped" 
for="group_@Model.filials[i].ID_Filial">@Model.filials[i].NameFilial @if (Model.filials[i].IsAvalib == false) {<p style="font-style: italic; color:red; margin: 0; margin-left: 5px;"> (Филиал не работает)</p> }</label> 
                                        <div></div> 
                                    } 
                                </div> 
                            </div> 
                        </div> 
                    </th> 
                </tr> 
            </table> 
            <span asp-validation-for="@Model.filials" style="color: red;"></span> 
            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-evenly; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 20px;">                  <div class="btn-center"> 
                    <input class="sbm-zvonok" id="sbbtn" type="submit" value="@if (Model.ID_Worker == 0) { 
<text>Добавить</text>} else{<text>Изменить</text>}" /> 
                </div> 
                <div class="btn-center"> 
                    <a href="/ManageCadri" class="sbm-zvonok otm" style="background-color: #c4c4c4; color: White;"><p style="line-height: 0.2;">Отмена</p></a> 
                </div> 
            </div> 
        </form> 
        <script> 
            $('#inn').mask('000000000000'); 
            $('#snils').mask('000-000-000 00'); 
            $('#serpasp').mask('0000'); 
            $('#numbpasp').mask('000000'); 
            $('#phonenumber').mask('+7(000)000-00-00'); 
            function search_group() { 
                let input = document.getElementById('search-field_orgped').value;                 input = input.toLowerCase(); 
                let x = document.getElementsByClassName('search__element_orgped'); 
 
                for (i = 0; i < x.length; i++) { 
                    if (!x[i].innerHTML.toLowerCase().includes(input)) { 
                        if (!x[i].classList.contains('name_spec'))                             x[i].style.display = "none"; 
                    } else { 
                        x[i].style.display = "block"; 
                    } 
                } 
            } 
        </script> 
    </div> 
</main> 
 
Index.cshtml 
@model IndexPageCadri; 
<link rel="stylesheet" href="~/css/styletovarilist.css"> 
@{ 
    ViewData["Title"] = "Сотрудники"; 
} 
<main class="content-main" style="max-width: 1190px; margin: 0 auto;     flex-direction: row;     justify-content: space-between; 
    align-items: stretch;     max-width: 1190px;     padding: 0 13px;">         <div> 
            <div class="filter" style="padding-left: 25px; padding-right: 25px; margin-top: 25px;">                 <div style="display:flex;"> 
                    <button id="rabotSotr" style="margin-top: 10px; margin-right: 15px;" class="disabledbtn btn btn_outline btn_primary filter__submit">Работающие сотрудники</button> 
                    <button id="uvolsSotr" style="margin-top: 10px;" class="btn btn_outline btn_primary filter__submit">Уволенные сотрудники</button> 
                </div>                 <div> 
                    <div class="filter__title">Фамилия имя сотрудника:</div> 
                    <div class="filter-range-preview"> 
 	 	 	 	        <input style="margin: 0; text-align: left;" class="filter-rangepreview__input" id="searchf"> 
 	 	 	        </div> 
                </div> 
                <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between;"> 
                    <div> 
                        <div class="filter__title">Сортировать по:</div> 
                        <div class="filter-range-preview"> 
                            <select id="typesort" name="typesort" style="width: 100%;"> 
                              <option value="0">По умолчанию</option> 
                              <option value="1">По фамилии имени</option>                               <option value="2">По дате рождения</option> 
                            </select> 
 	 	 	            </div> 
                    </div> 
                    <div> 
                        <div class="filter__title">Должность:</div> 
                         <div class="filter-range-preview"> 
                            <select id="dolzhnost" name="dolzhnost" style="width: 100%;"> 
                              <option value="0">Любая</option> 
                              <option value="9">Сотрудники отдела кадров</option> 
                              <option value="15">Сотрудники склада магазина</option>

                $('#modDialog').show();

@model CategoriesSite; 
<div class="modal-content"> 
    @Html.AntiForgeryToken() 
    <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="~/css/style_list.css" /> 
    <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="~/css/styleInputFile.css" /> 
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/icon?family=Material+Icons" rel="stylesheet"> 
    <script src="~/lib/jQuery-Mask-Plugin-master/dist/jquery.mask.js"></script> 
    <div class="modal-windows"> 
        <div class="obratnii-zvonok modal-body"> 
            <div class="form-edit fformms" style="padding: 30px; background-color: #fff; border-radius: 5px; boxshadow: 1px 1px 10px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 12%); color: #696969; "> 
                <div class="zvonok-title">@if (Model.CategoryId == 0) { <text>Добавление</text>} else{<text>Изменение</text>} категории</div> 
                <form asp-action="AddEditPost" asp-controller="ManageCategori" asp-route-id="@Model.CategoryId" method="post" class="callback-from" enctype="multipart/form-data"> 
                    <input name="IsValid" type="hidden" value="@ViewData.ModelState.IsValid.ToString()" /> 
                    <div> 
                        <div class="form-zap"> 
                            <label asp-for="@Model.CategoryName" class="required"></label> 
                            <input type="text" asp-for="@Model.CategoryName" class="inputs imz-in" /> 
                            <span asp-validation-for="@Model.CategoryName" style="color: red;"></span> 
                        </div> 
                        <div class="form-zap"> 
                            <div style="margin-top: 5px;"> 
                                <input type="checkbox" id="checkend" asp-for="@Model.IsMain"/> 
                                <label for="checkend">Отображение сверху</label> 
                                <span asp-validation-for="@Model.IsMain" style="color: red;"></span> 
                            </div> 
                        </div> 
                    </div> 
                </form> 
                <div class="btn-center"> 
                    <input class="sbm-zvonok" id="subbtnff" type="button" value="@if (Model.CategoryId == 0) { <text>Добавить</text>} else{<text>Изменить</text>}" /> 
                </div> 
                <div class="btn-center"> 
                    <button class="sbm-zvonok otm" style="background-color: #c4c4c4; margin-top: 15px; color: White;" onclick='$(".modal-content").remove();'>Отмена</button> 
                </div> 
                    <script> 
                        $("#subbtnff").click(function (e) {                             var placeholderElement = $('.modal');                             var form = $(this).parents('.modal').find('form');                             var actionUrl = form.attr('action');                             var dataToSend = form.serialize(); 
 
                            $.post(actionUrl, dataToSend).done(function (data) {                                 var newBody = $('.modal-body', data);                                 placeholderElement.find('.modal-body').replaceWith(newBody);                                 var isValid = newBody.find('[name="IsValid"]').val() == 'True';                                 if (newBody.find('[name="IsValid"]').val() == undefined || 
newBody.find('[name="IsValid"]').val() == 'True') { 
                                    $(".modal-content").remove(); 
                                    var urls = '@Url.Action("GetAllCategory", "ManageCategori")?search=' + $("#searchf").val() +'&typesort='+$("#typesort").val()+'&type='+$("#type").val(); 
                                    $('#panel').load(urls); 
                                } 
                            }); 
                        }); 
                </script> 
            </div> 
        </div> 
    <script src="~/lib/jquery-validation/dist/jquery.validate.min.js" defer></script> 
    <script src="~/lib/jquery-validation-unobtrusive/jquery.validate.unobtrusive.min.js" defer></script>     </div> 
</div>

Index.cshtml 
<link rel="stylesheet" href="~/css/styletovarilist.css"> 
@{ 
    ViewData["Title"] = "Категории сайта"; 
} 
<main class="content-main" style="max-width: 1190px; margin: 0 auto;     flex-direction: row;     justify-content: space-between; 
    align-items: stretch;     max-width: 1190px;     padding: 0 13px;">         <div> 
            <div class="filter" style="padding-left: 25px; padding-right: 25px; margin-top: 25px;"> 
                <div> 
                    <div class="filter__title">Наименование категории:</div> 
                    <div class="filter-range-preview"> 
 	 	 	 	        <input style="margin: 0; text-align: left;" class="filter-rangepreview__input" id="searchf"> 
 	 	 	        </div> 
                </div> 
                <div style="display: flex;"> 
                    <div style="margin-right: 15px;"> 
                        <div class="filter__title">Сортировать по:</div> 
                        <div class="filter-range-preview"> 
                            <select id="typesort" name="typesort" style="width: 100%;"> 
                              <option value="0">По умолчанию</option>                               <option value="1">По наименованию</option> 
                            </select> 
 	 	 	            </div> 
                    </div> 
                    <div> 
                        <div class="filter__title">Виды:</div> 
                         <div class="filter-range-preview"> 
                            <select id="type" name="type" style="width: 100%;"> 
                              <option value="0">Все</option> 
                              <option value="1">Только главные сверху</option>                               <option value="2">Только обычные</option> 
                            </select> 
 	 	 	            </div> 
                    </div> 
                </div> 
                <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between;"> 
                    <button id="btn_filters" style="margin-top: 10px;" class="btn btn_outline btn_primary filter__submit">Применить</button> 
                    <a id="addAdds" asp-action="AddEditCategory" asp-controller="ManageCategori" asp-routeid="0"><button style="margin-top: 10px;" class="btn btn_outline btn_primary filter__submit">Добавить категорию</button></a> 
                </div> 
        </div> 
        <div style="padding-top: 25px;" id="panel"></div> 
    </div> 
    <script type="text/javascript"> 
        var urls = '@Url.Action("GetAllCategory", "ManageCategori")'; 
        $('#panel').load(urls); 
        $("#btn_filters").click(function(){ 
            var urls = '@Url.Action("GetAllCategory", "ManageCategori")?search=' + $("#searchf").val() +'&typesort='+$("#typesort").val()+'&type='+$("#type").val(); 
            $('#panel').load(urls); 
        }); 
        $("#addAdds").click(function (e) {             $.ajaxSetup({ cache: false });             e.preventDefault(); 
            $.get(this.href, function (data) { 
                $('#dialogContent').html(data); 
                $('#modDialog').show(); 
            }); 
        }); 
        function deleteConfirm(theObject){ 
            $.ajaxSetup({ cache: false }); 
            $.get('/ManageCategori/ConfirmDelete/'+theObject, function (data) { 
                $('#dialogContent').html(data); 
                $('#modDialog').show(); 
            }); 
        } 
        function editAdds(theObject){             $.ajaxSetup({ cache: false }); 
            $.get('/ManageCategori/AddEditCategory/'+theObject, function (data) { 
                $('#dialogContent').html(data); 
                $('#modDialog').show(); 
            }); 
        } 
    </script> 
</main>

          fetch('api/Filials/OpenFilial/@Model.IdFilial', { method: 'GET' })             .then(() => { 
                $('#panel').load(urls); 
                $(".modal-content").remove(); 
            }); 
        }); 
    </script> 
</div>

Index.cshtml 
<link rel="stylesheet" href="~/css/styletovarilist.css"> 
@{ 
    ViewData["Title"] = "Филиалы"; 
} 
<main class="content-main" style="max-width: 1190px; margin: 0 auto;     flex-direction: row;     justify-content: space-between; 
    align-items: stretch;     max-width: 1190px;     padding: 0 13px;">         <div> 
            <div class="filter" style="padding-left: 25px; padding-right: 25px; margin-top: 25px;"> 
                <div> 
                    <div class="filter__title">Наименование/адрес филиала:</div> 
                    <div class="filter-range-preview"> 
 	 	 	 	        <input style="margin: 0; text-align: left;" class="filter-rangepreview__input" id="searchf"> 
 	 	 	        </div> 
                </div> 
                <div style="display: flex;"> 
                    <div style="margin-right: 15px;"> 
                        <div class="filter__title">Сортировать по:</div> 
                        <div class="filter-range-preview"> 
                            <select id="typesort" name="typesort" style="width: 100%;"> 
                              <option value="0">По умолчанию</option> 
                              <option value="1">По наименованию</option> 
                            </select> 
 	 	 	            </div> 
                    </div> 
                    <div> 
                        <div class="filter__title">Работающий:</div> 
                         <div class="filter-range-preview"> 
                            <select id="type" name="type" style="width: 100%;"> 
                              <option value="0">Все</option> 
                              <option value="1" selected>Только работающие</option> 
                              <option value="2">Только закрытые</option> 
                            </select> 
 	 	 	            </div> 
                    </div>                 </div> 
                <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between;"> 
                    <button id="btn_filters" style="margin-top: 10px;" class="btn btn_outline btn_primary filter__submit">Применить</button> 
                    <a id="addAdds" asp-action="AddEditFilial" asp-controller="ManageFilials" asp-route-id="0"><button style="margin-top: 10px;" class="btn btn_outline btn_primary filter__submit">Добавить филиал</button></a> 
                </div> 
        </div> 
        <div style="padding-top: 25px;" id="panel"></div> 
    </div> 
    <script type="text/javascript"> 
        var urls = '@Url.Action("GetAllFilials", "ManageFilials")?type=1'; 
        $('#panel').load(urls); 
        $("#btn_filters").click(function(){ 
            urls = '@Url.Action("GetAllFilials", "ManageFilials")?search=' + $("#searchf").val() 
+'&typesort='+$("#typesort").val()+'&type='+$("#type").val(); 
            $('#panel').load(urls); 
        }); 
        $("#addAdds").click(function (e) {             $.ajaxSetup({ cache: false });             e.preventDefault(); 
            $.get(this.href, function (data) { 
                $('#dialogContent').html(data); 
                $('#modDialog').show(); 
            }); 
        }); 
        function closeFilial(theObject){             $.ajaxSetup({ cache: false }); 
            $.get('/ManageFilials/ConfirmClose/'+theObject, function (data) { 
                $('#dialogContent').html(data); 
                $('#modDialog').show(); 
            }); 
        } 
        function openFilial(theObject){             $.ajaxSetup({ cache: false }); 
            $.get('/ManageFilials/ConfirmOpen/'+theObject, function (data) { 
                $('#dialogContent').html(data); 
                $('#modDialog').show(); 
            }); 
        } 
 
        function editFilial(theObject){             $.ajaxSetup({ cache: false }); 
            $.get('/ManageFilials/AddEditFilial/'+theObject, function (data) { 
                $('#dialogContent').html(data); 
                $('#modDialog').show(); 
            }); 
        } 
    </script> 
</main>

_OrderContainerInformation.cshtml 
@model OrderAboutManageOrders                                   
@foreach (var items in Model.listTovari) 
{ 
    <div class="basket-item"> 
        <div class="basket__row"> 
            <div class="basket__col basket__col_image"> 
                <img src="@items.Goods.FtppathImage" alt="product image"> 
            </div> 
            <div class="basket__col basket__col_name"> 
                <div class="basket-item__name"> 
                    <a asp-action="Tovar" asp-controller="Categori" asp-route-
id="@items.Goods.IdGood"><b>@items.Goods.Manufacture.NameManufacture</b> @items.Goods.Name</a> 
                </div> 
            </div> 
            <div class="basket__col basket__col_quanity"> 
                <div class="number-input"> 
                    <a style="height: 50%;" id="do-@items.ContainerID" class="number-input__btn btn_primary minus" data-decrease=""> 
                        <svg style="display: block; margin: 4px auto;" class="icon" width="9" height="6" viewBox="0 0 9 6" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"> 
                            <path d="M8.59117 1.56267C8.77524 1.36954 8.77524 1.06591 8.59117 0.872772L8.28019 
0.546462C8.08317 0.339729 7.75331 0.33973 7.55629 0.546462L4.98895 3.24033C4.79192 3.44707 4.46206 
3.44707 4.26504 3.24033L1.6977 0.546462C1.50068 0.339729 1.17082 0.339729 0.973798 0.546461L0.662814 
0.872771C0.478749 1.06591 0.478749 1.36954 0.662814 1.56267L4.26504 5.34244C4.46206 5.54917 4.79192 
5.54917 4.98894 5.34244L8.59117 1.56267Z" fill="white" /> 
                        </svg> 
                    </a> 
                    <input readonly="readonly" type="number" onsklad="@items.count_filial" id="kolichest@items.ContainerID" class="input number-input__input" min="1" value="@items.Count" name="productquantity"> 
                    <a style="height: 50%;" id="up-@items.ContainerID" class="number-input__btn btn_primary addplus" data-increase=""> 
                        <svg style="display: block; margin: 4px auto;" class="icon" width="9" height="6" viewBox="0 0 9 6" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"> 
                            <path d="M0.634901 4.15956C0.450837 4.35269 0.450836 4.65632 0.634901 4.84946L0.945884 
5.17577C1.14291 5.3825 1.47277 5.3825 1.66979 5.17577L4.23713 2.4819C4.43415 2.27516 4.76401 2.27516 
4.96103 2.4819L7.52837 5.17577C7.7254 5.3825 8.05525 5.3825 8.25228 5.17577L8.56326 4.84946C8.74733 
4.65632 8.74733 4.35269 8.56326 4.15956L4.96103 0.379793C4.76401 0.173061 4.43415 0.17306 4.23713 
0.379793L0.634901 4.15956Z" fill="white" /> 
                        </svg> 
                    </a> 
                </div> 
            </div> 
 
            <div class="basket__col basket__col_price"> 
                <div class="basket-price"> 
                    @((items.Count * Convert.ToDouble(items.costOrder)).ToString())<span class="basketprice__currency">₽</span> 
                </div> 
            </div> 
        </div> 
    </div> 
} 
<div class="basket__col basket__col_footer"> 
    <div style="text-align:left; margin-left:25px;" class="basket-summary"> 
        <div>Общая стоимость товаров: @Model.SummaOrder ₽</div> 
    </div> 
</div> 
 
<script> 
      var initial; 
      $(".addplus").click(function() { 
        addplus($(this)); 
      }) 
      function addplus(thisObj){           clearTimeout(initial);           var thisObj = thisObj;           var id = $(thisObj).attr("id");           id = id.substring(3, id.length +1); 
          if (Number(document.getElementById('kolichest-'+id).value) + 1 <= Number(Number($("#kolichest-
"+id).attr("onsklad"))+Number(document.getElementById('kolichest-'+id).value))) { 
              document.getElementById('kolichest-'+id).value = Number(document.getElementById('kolichest-
'+id).value) + 1; 
              var newKolvo = document.getElementById('kolichest-'+id).value;               initial = setTimeout(function() { 
                  $.ajax({                       type: "GET", 
                      url: '/api/Order/UpdateOrder/'+id+'/'+newKolvo,                       dataType: "text"                   }).done(function() { 
                    $('#panel_cart').load('@Url.Action("GetOrderContainer", "ManageOrders", new {id = 
@Model.ID_Order})'); 
                  }); 
              }, 500); 
          }           else 
            alert("Вы превысили количество товара, доступное на складе"); 
      }; 
 
      $(".minus").click(function() { 
        minus($(this)); 
      }) 
      function minus(thisObj){           clearTimeout(initial);           var thisObj = thisObj;           var id = $(thisObj).attr("id");           id = id.substring(3, id.length +1); 
          if (Number(document.getElementById('kolichest-'+id).value) - 1 > 0) { 
              document.getElementById('kolichest-'+id).value = Number(document.getElementById('kolichest-
'+id).value) - 1; 
              var newKolvo = document.getElementById('kolichest-'+id).value;               initial = setTimeout(function() { 
                  $.ajax({                       type: "GET", 
                      url: '/api/Order/UpdateOrder/'+id+'/'+newKolvo,                       dataType: "text"                   }).done(function() { 
                    $('#panel_cart').load('@Url.Action("GetOrderContainer", "ManageOrders", new {id = @Model.ID_Order})'); 
                  }); 
              }, 500); 
          }           else 
              alert("Меньше единицы товаров быть не может"); 
      }; 
</script>

                                        <div id="BackStatus" style="background-color: #c62306; border-color: #c62306; color: 
#fff; width: fit-content; cursor: pointer; line-height: 1.8;" class="btn btn_primary basket-submit__btn" >Вернуть на сборку</div> 
                                    </div> 
                                </div>

 	 	 	                            <polygon  style="fill: #C62306;" points="57.179,223.413 
51.224,217.276 159.925,111.71 51.224,6.127 57.179,0 172.189,111.71         "/> 
                                    </svg> 
                                </div> 
                                <div> 
                                    <p class="dostavka" style="max-width: 200px; align-items: center; text-align: center; color: 
white; background: #2780ff; font-weight: bold; cursor: default;">Ожидает выдачи</p> 
                                </div> 
                                <div> 
                                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" height="35" width="35" style="fill: #C62306;" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" version="1.1" id="Capa_1" x="0px" y="0px" viewBox="0 0 223.413 223.413" xml:space="preserve"> 
 	 	 	                            <polygon  style="fill: #C62306;" points="57.179,223.413 
51.224,217.276 159.925,111.71 51.224,6.127 57.179,0 172.189,111.71         "/> 
                                    </svg>

                                <div style="margin-left: 15px;">                                     <div class="basket-submit"> 
                                        <div id="NextStatus" style="background-color: #c62306; border-color: #c62306; color: #fff; width: fit-content; cursor: pointer; line-height: 1.8;" class="btn btn_primary basket-submit__btn" >Выдать заказ</div> 
                                    </div> 
                                </div> 
                            </div> 
                        } 
                        else if(Model.StatusOrder == 2) 
                        { 
                            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center;"> 
                                <div> 
                                    <p class="dostavka" style="max-width: 200px; align-items: center; text-align: center; background: #c4daff; font-weight: bold; cursor: default;">Подтверждён. Сборка</p> 
                                </div> 
                            </div> 
                        } 
 
                        @if(Model.StatusOrder == 3) 
                        { 
                            <p class="dostavka" style="max-width: 200px; align-items: center; color: white; text-align: center; background: #3ebb46; font-weight: bold; cursor: default;">Завершён. Выдан покупателю</p> 
                        } 
                        @if(Model.StatusOrder == 4) 
                        { 
                            <p class="dostavka" style="max-width: 260px; align-items: center; text-align: center; color: white; background: #555054; font-weight: bold; cursor: default; ">Завершён. Отменён</p> 
                        } 
                    </div> 
                </div> 
                <div class="form-group profiles-form__input" style="width:100%;"> 
                   @if(Model.DateReadyToExtradition != null) 
                   { 
                       <p style="margin: 0.2rem;"><b>Дата и время сборки заказа:</b> 
@Model.DateReadyToExtradition</p> 
                       <p style="margin: 0.2rem; margin-bottom: 10px;"><b>Сборщик:</b> @Model.Sborshik</p> 
                   } 
                   @if(Model.DateExtradition != null)

                       <p style="margin: 0.2rem;"><b>Дата и время выдчи заказа:</b> @Model.DateExtradition</p>                        <p style="margin: 0.2rem;"><b>Выдал:</b> @Model.Vidal</p> 
                   } 
                </div> 
            </div> 
        </div> 
    </div> 
</div> 
<script> 
    $('#deleteOrder').click(async function(e) {  
        let a = await fetch('/api/Order/CancelOrder/@Model.ID_Order', {           method: 'DELETE', 
        }) 
        .then(res => res.text()) 
        .then(); 
         $('#status_order').load('@Url.Action("GetOrderStatus", "ManageOrders", new {id = @Model.ID_Order})'); 
    }); 
 
    $('#NextStatus').click(async function(e) {  
        let a = await fetch('/api/Order/NextStatus/@Model.ID_Order/@Model.WorkerUserID', {           method: 'PUT', 
        }) 
        .then(res => res.text()) 
        .then(); 
         $('#status_order').load('@Url.Action("GetOrderStatus", "ManageOrders", new {id = @Model.ID_Order})'); 
    }); 
    $('#BackStatus').click(async function(e) {  
        let a = await fetch('/api/Order/BackStatus/@Model.ID_Order', {           method: 'PUT', 
        }) 
        .then(res => res.text()) 
        .then(); 
         $('#status_order').load('@Url.Action("GetOrderStatus", "ManageOrders", new {id = @Model.ID_Order})'); 
    }); 
</script>

href="https://yandex.ru/maps/213/moscow/search/@Model.FilialAddress" target="_blank">@Model.FilialAddress</a>)</label>
